messages:
maria: Quick design ping — trying a 'ghost lineage' lane in the rollout timeline to show forks vs straight history. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/rollout-timeline#node-id=123. Can people scan for clarity, semantics, and a11y pitfalls?

owen: Nice at-a-glance. Concern: ghost lane could be read as a merge. Maybe micro-label on hover/focus: 'forked from v3.1'.

maria: Hover labels exist but won't help keyboard/SR users alone. Sam?

sam: If it conveys structure it must have a text alternative. Make nodes focusable and provide a succinct description (e.g., 'v3.2 — forked from v3.1 — 20% traffic'). Use list/listitem roles so assistive tech groups them. Also don't rely on color/opacity alone. :point_up: 

devin: Implementation idea: nodes as buttons with aria-describedby pointing to an sr-only description. Example: <button aria-describedby="v3-2-desc">v3.2</button> with a hidden span id="v3-2-desc" saying 'Forked from v3.1, 20% traffic'.

chloe: Perf note — some customers have ~200 versions. Eagerly rendering 200 sr-only spans might bloat the DOM. Can we lazy-create the descriptions on focus or virtualize the timeline?

sam: I recommend a collapsed summary (e.g., '20 versions — use arrow keys to navigate') and only materialize per-node descriptions on focus or expand. Use an aria-live polite region to announce expansion. Also ensure live announcements aren't spammy when quickly arrowing.

maria: Visual tweak: ghost line at 35% opacity reads decorative. Since it's semantic, increase stroke weight or use a dashed pattern for forks vs linear.

owen: Keyboard order must match visual LTR. If the timeline wraps, keep DOM order consistent so Tab/arrow navigation feels natural.

devin: I'll prototype keyboard nav: left/right arrows to move focus, Enter/Space to open details, single live region to announce 'v3.2 focused — forked from v3.1, 20% traffic'. Will wire lazy DOM creation for sr descriptions.

chloe: I'll run perf sims with 50/100/200 nodes and compare eager vs lazy sr nodes. If virtualization is required it affects animation and focus management — we'll decide early.

sam: Once prototype exists I'll test NVDA/VoiceOver and keyboard-only flows, and ensure focus ring is visible in high-contrast modes.

maria: Action items: devin -> prototype; sam -> SR testing; chloe -> perf analysis. Sync tomorrow 11:00am PT. Thanks :thumbsup:
